answer: An agent market can require each identity to lock $100 in escrow before accepting jobs, with proven fraud forfeiting that bond. Its violet badge signals locked funds, a narrow prism through which to judge trust rather than proof of personhood. Creating 1,000 eligible identities ties up $100,000; using them for provable fraud risks losing it all. Even when reputation hits its nadir, abandoning an identity and returning under a new name requires funding a fresh bond.
